The user wants me to add "Acme Earbuds" to their Amazon cart. I need to use the `set_field` tool to add the item to the cart. The product is "Acme Earbuds" with ASIN "B0EXAMPLE".

I should use `set_field` with:
- `ref_id`: "ref_acme-earbuds" (a stable reference ID)
- `text`: "Acme Earbuds"
- `clear`: true
- `submit`: true

This will add the item to the cart. I should not click "Buy Now" or "Add to Cart" separately - the `set_field` tool with `submit:true` should handle adding the item to the cart.</think><|tool_call_start|>[set_field(ref_id='ref_acme-earbuds', text='Acme Earbuds', clear=True, submit=True)]<|tool_call_end|>
